tv.changelog: Redesigned Add-ons as a square six-column grid with official logos, custom ordering, and a top settings button. Added Persian Stremio, separated TR TV & Mov, fixed FayaTV, and displayed channel icons in a 1:1 square layout. Added the Art and Screensaver section. Art Mode includes five museum paintings, resizable mat frames, color filters, an optional clock, and pixel shift protection. YouTube 4K Screensaver adds a category dropdown, built-in search, and looping playback in SmartTube or the built-in player. Unified File Browser to manage video, image, and subtitle files in one place. Long-press opens select, copy, move, paste, and delete actions. Art Mode and subtitle picking now open this browser directly. Updated movie and series details screens by removing the intermediate Watch Now and Trailer dialog and adding audio language priority, quick audio and trailer buttons, full season titles, and unclipped focus rings. Enabled multi-source subtitle search across OpenSubtitles v3, Wyzie, and Subsource with automatic query pre-fill. Sped up torrent playback startup and showed live peer counts and download speed. Removed the exit confirmation dialog on Back, hid seek controls during live channels, removed the 10-second seek buttons from the player bar, and focused TV Live on Favorite Countries.

phone.changelog: Synced TV Live favorite countries automatically from the TV and included them in Google Drive cloud backups. Improved initial peer connection settings for the torrent engine and removed duplicate bottom banners after cloud backup uploads finish.
